verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Typesense supports pushing/importing bulk data at large scale (millions of records, e.g. 2.2M recipes, 32M songs dataset) and provides indexing/search functionality, but there is no evidence of an async task-tracking mechanism (e.g. job IDs, polling for import completion status) that platform engineers could use to monitor long-running bulk imports. Missing for 10: documentation of async import job status/tracking API, evidence of import progress polling, and any independent benchmark of import throughput at scale.
